Class SshConnectionPanel

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshConnectionPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class SshConnectionPanel extends JPanel
The SshConnectionPanel is the connection bar. The bar holds the host, the port, the user, the password, and the session mode. Connect, disconnect, and the other buttons call the SshConnectionPanel.Listener. The frame owns the panel. The bottom pad is 4 pixels, which keeps the buttons clear of the joint. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshConnectionPanel

  • Constructor Details

    • SshConnectionPanel

      public SshConnectionPanel(SshClientProperties properties, SshClientTheme theme, SshConnectionPanel.Listener listener)
      The constructor builds the connection bar from the stored fields. The password is filled only when remember-password is already set. The font control is a minus button, the size, and a plus button. The size runs from 8 to 36. The bar starts in the disconnected state. Close Pane starts disabled.
      Parameters:
      properties - The properties object is the persistence store.
      theme - The theme is the dark painter.
      listener - The listener receives the button actions.

  • Method Details

    • applyConnectionState

      public void applyConnectionState(SshConnectionState state)
      The method enables Connect, Disconnect, Reconnect, and Load File from the session state. A null state is treated as disconnected. A connected state turns Connect off and turns Disconnect, Reconnect, and Load File on. A connecting state turns those four buttons off. Any other state turns Connect on and turns Disconnect, Reconnect, and Load File off. New Term and Clear Terminal stay enabled. armConnectForChoice() may turn Connect back on for a different username.
      Parameters:
      state - The state is the current connection state.

    • noteLiveUser

      void noteLiveUser(String user)
      The method records the user this pane is actually holding. An empty value means the link is down. A null value is stored as empty. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-132
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the live username, or empty.

    • armConnectForChoice

      private void armConnectForChoice()
      The method enables Connect when the chosen name differs from the live name. The live name leaves Connect off while the session is connected. A connecting session is left alone.

    • setClosePaneEnabled

      public void setClosePaneEnabled(boolean enabled)
      The method enables or disables Close Pane. The last pane cannot be closed, so the caller passes false for that pane.
      Parameters:
      enabled - The flag is true when Close Pane is usable.

    • persistConnectionFields

      public void persistConnectionFields()
      The method stores the host, the port, the username, the remember flag, and the password. The password is kept only when Remember password is selected. The account list is updated from those same fields. The username combo is reloaded without losing the typed name. The store is written to disk.

    • refreshUsernameChoices

      public void refreshUsernameChoices()
      The method reloads the combo items from the store. The typed name stays selected. The reload does not fire a user-choice event.

      The method sets the bar to the application point size. A size below 8 becomes 8. A size above 36 becomes 36. Labels, fields, buttons, and the thinking cluster take that face together. Tool tips and the Load File width are applied again.
      Parameters:
      fontSize - The font size is the incrementor value.

    • seatBarTips

      private void seatBarTips()
      The method sets a tool tip on every control on the connection bar. The font incrementor buttons and the size field each receive a tip. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-157

    • seatSendFileWidth

      private void seatSendFileWidth()
      The method sizes Load File so the full word stays visible. The width is the text, the insets, and three ems. The extra ems clear the round edge. The height follows the font and the insets. A missing measurement becomes 1. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-157

    • seatBarFont

      private void seatBarFont(Component node, Font font)
      The method sets the font on one bar control and then on its children. Labels, buttons, text fields, and combos take the font. A combo editor takes the font.
      Parameters:
      node - The node is a control or a row.
      font - The font is the application face.

    • layoutControls

      private void layoutControls()
      The method lays the host fields on the first row. The button row sits under that row. The font control sits on the button row, after Close Pane. A thin rule separates Close Pane from the font label.

    • holdThink

      void holdThink(JComponent cluster)
      The method remembers the thinking cluster. The folded row may become its parent. // @aa-sdd PK-1099 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md FINESSE:f-180

    • parkThink

      void parkThink()
      The method places the thinking cluster to the right of the font control. A missing cluster or a missing button row returns. A cluster that is already on the button row returns. The cluster font is clamped from 8 to 36.

      private JLabel flowLabel(String text, String tip)
      The method builds a themed label for the host row. The label shows the tool tip.

    • wireEvents

      private void wireEvents()
      The method wires the buttons, the focus-lost save, the mode confirm, and the font incrementor. Connect and Reconnect save the fields before they call the listener. Disconnect, Clear Terminal, Load File, New Term, and Close Pane call the listener without an extra save. Close Pane starts disabled. Leaving the host, the port, or the username editor saves the fields. Pressing Enter in the host or the port saves the fields. Choosing a remembered username fills its password and selects Remember password when a password is stored. A chosen name that is not the live user calls SshConnectionPanel.Listener.usernameChosen(). A mode change asks for confirmation in handleModeSelection(). A font change saves the size and calls SshConnectionPanel.Listener.fontSizeChanged(int).

    • scheduleFont

      private void scheduleFont()
      The method restarts the 800 millisecond font timer. A field update that this class itself wrote does not restart the timer.

    • applyFontNow

      private void applyFontNow(int next)
      The method stores a font size at once and stops the timer. A size below 8 is stored as 8. A size above 36 is stored as 36. A size equal to the current size only refreshes the field. A different size updates the field, saves it, and reports it.
      Parameters:
      next - The next value is the size to apply.

    • applyTypedFont

      private void applyTypedFont()
      The method applies the text in the font field. A null or blank field restores the current size and does not notify. A value that is not an integer restores the current size and does not notify. An integer is passed to applyFontNow(int).

    • showFont

      private void showFont()
      The method writes the current font size into the field. A field that already shows that size is left alone. The write does not restart the timer.

    • handleModeSelection

      private void handleModeSelection()
      The method confirms a mode change before it is stored. A selection that matches the stored mode returns. The dialog says the session will disconnect and reconnect when a session is connected. Cancel restores the stored mode without another event. Yes stores the mode and calls SshConnectionPanel.Listener.modeChangeRequested(SshSessionMode).
